verdicts.reason: Both break the design apart: the flavour labels are cut off from their cans, and two cans have shrunk to specks. A keeps the logo centred like the original. In B, the CTA and badge are crammed together above the headline.
The two layouts are almost the same. B's headline has more breathing room at the canvas edges, while A's runs nearly edge to edge.
B keeps the original arrangement: three cans, each with its own label, then the CTA and footer. A jumbles the flavour text, enlarges one can and shrinks the other two to specks.
A faithfully keeps the original's structure, hierarchy and readable spacing. B loses the can-to-flavour pairing and shrinks two cans to specks.
